name: Mission ONE Don't Give Up
source:
Join ONE on their mission to make their sister feel better. Things don't always goes as plan but all you can do is learn and don't give up.

[From [url=https://acesscribbles.itch.io/missionone]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
加入ONE的行动，一起设法让姐姐开心起来吧。事情并不总会按计划发展，但你能做的就是从中吸取经验，绝不轻言放弃。

[引自[url=https://acesscribbles.itch.io/missionone]Itch.io[/url]]
